desc:
After achieving several podium finishes at the last World Shotgun Championships with its unrivaled cycling speed, the 1301 Comp has evolved into the Pro version following the implementation of suggestions made by Beretta's multiple medal-winning shooters.

With the comfort, stability, and easy swing offered by the new stock, the ultra-fast, safe loading system, the new oversized cocking handle, and bolt release lever, the 1301 Comp Pro is now, even in its standard configuration, the most competitive dynamic shooting platform, but has plenty of capacity for further personalization and is therefore very sought after by the most demanding of shooters.
